gift_only.description: Defaults to false. When true, direct cart additions are rejected with CART_GIFT_ONLY; the product can be added only as an eligible free gift. This flag does not hide the product from listings.

hs_code.description: Customs HS code. See hs_code_max_length and the field constraints in GET /products/limits.

images.description: Gallery entries: {file_id, alt_text?, sort_order?}. Files may be images, videos, or 3D models. Non-empty file_id values require read_files. On update, the array replaces the gallery; [] clears it. The store’s max_images limit applies.

inventory.description: Simple products with inventory_source=track. Rows are {location_id, quantity, low_stock_threshold?, expected_quantity?}. Quantities are non-negative integers within the store’s limits. On update, only named locations change. expected_quantity is the on-hand value previously read (0 for a missing row); a mismatch returns 409 PRODUCT_VERSION_STALE. You may use merchant-managed locations or locations owned by your app’s active installation.

inventory_group_id.description: Inventory-group UUID. Required with inventory_source=group. The group must belong to this store. Simple products only.

inventory_source.description: Simple-product inventory mode: track for per-location stock, none for untracked stock, or group for an inventory-group link. Defaults to track. Changing modes on update may require confirmation. Allowed values: `track`, `none`, `group`. Simple products only.

length.description: Positive package length within the store’s limit.

max_order_quantity.description: Optional per-order quantity cap, independent of inventory mode. On update, 0 clears the explicit cap; omission or null leaves it unchanged. Without an explicit cap, the store’s default order cap may still apply.

metafields.description: Values as {definition_id, value}. Definitions must target products and permit your app to write them. On update, this array replaces the set your app can write; [] clears that set. Use the dedicated metafield endpoint for writes addressed by namespace and key.

mpn.description: Optional manufacturer part number. Not required to be unique. See mpn_max_length.

no_manufacturer_identifiers.description: Set true only if the product has no manufacturer identifiers. Cannot be true with a barcode or MPN. The response’s identifier_status is provided when identifiers exist, not_applicable when this flag is true, and unknown otherwise.

overall_low_stock_threshold.description: Overall low-stock threshold for directly tracked simple products. Uses total available stock across locations. Zero is valid. On update, null disables the alert and omission keeps it. Not available for untracked or group-backed stock. Simple products only.

Amounts are JSON decimal strings with the currency’s permitted precision. Include the base currency. On update, supplying this array replaces the complete price set. A sale price may be zero but must be below the regular price. The base-currency sale schedule applies to all currency sale prices; a non-base sale requires a base sale. Omit sale prices from the replacement set to remove them.

Accepts an ISO 8601 timestamp; include an offset for an explicit instant, or use the store timezone for a local timestamp. Stay within publish_max_days_ahead from GET /products/limits. type.description: Required on create: simple or variable. Cannot be changed after creation. Allowed values: `simple`, `variable`.

variants.description:
Variable products only; required (at least one variant). The initial variant set, validated together: combination uniqueness against the declared attributes, attribute coverage, at least one variant, and store-wide SKU uniqueness. Each entry:

- `sku` (string, required) — unique across the entire store.
- `attribute_values` (array, required) — One entry per declared attribute: `{attribute_id, option_id}` for an option choice, or `{attribute_id, value_text}` for a text value. Attribute and option ids come from `GET /attributes` (the product's `attribute_ids` must cover every `attribute_id` used). Two variants can never share the same combination.
- `prices` (array, required) — per-currency rows `{currency_code, regular_price, sale_price?, cost_price?, sale_starts_at?, sale_ends_at?}`; the base currency row is required. Amounts are decimal strings.
- `title` (string, optional) — auto-composed from option labels ("Red / M") unless supplied.
- `barcode` is variant-specific. `condition`, `mpn`, and `no_manufacturer_identifiers` can override the parent’s values. `identifier_status` describes whether identifiers are provided, unknown, or not applicable; use the identifier fields and declaration consistently.
- `weight`, `weight_unit`, `length`, `width`, `height`, `dimension_unit`, `hs_code`, `country_of_origin`, `requires_shipping` — physical overrides.
- `inventory_source` (`track` | `none` | `group`), `inventory` (per-location rows `{location_id, quantity, low_stock_threshold?, expected_quantity?}` when tracking), `inventory_group_id` (when `group`).
- `image_file_id` (string, optional) — Media-library upload UUID; non-empty values require `read_files` in addition to `write_products`. `image_id` selects an existing product gallery row and does not require `read_files`.
- `max_order_quantity` is an optional per-order cap; `overall_low_stock_threshold` applies only to directly tracked stock.

Create supplies the initial set here. Later edits use the delta fields on Product update; read operations use the paginated Variant endpoints.

description: List the store's enabled languages with the default flagged. Returns every enabled language with its locale code, display label, native name, selector label, text direction, and default-language status. The response also includes the store's language limit. Content is authored in the default language and translated into the others. This list is the catalog a storefront can publish. Assigning those languages to a specific storefront is an Online Store Admin action and is not part of this resource. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for GET /api/2025-01/languages. Only the connected store is accessible.
name: list_languages

description: Update the store's enabled language set. When `locales` is supplied, it is the complete set of locale codes the store should publish in. Repeated codes count once, and an identical set is a no-op that does not claim an update. Omitting `locales` leaves the enabled set unchanged. The default language must always be included in a supplied set — it cannot be removed here. Disabling a language permanently deletes its translations and requires confirmation: the first call that would remove locales returns `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` with warnings and a token bound to those locales; repeat with `confirmed: true` and that token. Adding languages does not require confirmation. A language that is assigned to a storefront is protected (remove it from those storefronts first), and the set size is capped by the store's plan. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/languages. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the first call's warning response when locales are being disabled.

confirmed.description: true on the second call, with the confirmation token, when locales are being disabled.

locales.description: Complete enabled set of locale codes, including the default. Omit it to leave languages unchanged.

name: set_languages

description: Change the store's default (source) language — a confirmed two-step. The selected language becomes the source language for store content. This does not translate existing source content into the new language. Any translations stored for the selected language are permanently removed because that language will now contain source content. The first call returns impact warnings and a confirmation token without making changes; repeat the request with `confirmed: true` and that token to continue. Tokens are short-lived and single-use. A successful change publishes `store/locales/update`. `store/translations/deleted` is published only when translations, translated storefront messages, or active translation work were actually removed. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for PUT /api/2025-01/languages/default. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the first call's warning response.

confirmed.description: true on the second call, with the confirmation token.

locale.description: Locale code to become the default. If it is not enabled yet, it is added when the plan limit allows.

name: set_default_language

description: Delete all translation data for one enabled language without disabling it. The first call returns warnings and a confirmation token without deleting anything. Repeat the request with `confirmed: true` and that token to permanently remove every stored content translation, translated storefront message, localized search document, pending AI suggestion, and translation CSV preview for the selected language. Active AI and CSV translation work is cancelled and cannot restore removed content. Completed import and export history remains available. The language remains enabled and its storefront assignments do not change. `store/translations/deleted` is published only when the reset removes data or cancels active work. The default language cannot be selected because it contains source content rather than translations. Uses the documented Store API fields, validation and permissions for DELETE /api/2025-01/languages/{locale}/translations. Only the connected store is accessible. Preserve omitted fields. Present confirmation impact before resubmitting with confirmation; inspect bulk success and failure results. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

confirmation_token.description: Token returned by the first call.

confirmed.description: true on the second call, with the confirmation token.

locale.description: Enabled non-default locale whose translation data should be removed.

name: delete_language_translations
